paper_claim: Equal active vehicle-hours did not yield equal effective service capacity across compositions.

paper_claim: Peak service fell and queue pressure rose along the HV-to-AV anchor sequence.

paper_claim: The dominant operational-envelope dimensions changed with assumed capability.
supporting_scenario_or_metric: Mean positive activity by profile and family
scope_guardrail: Exposure is reference-envelope utilization, not safety or failure probability.
